title: Updating the input length
statement: For any counting-algorithm state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, replacing coordinate $0$ of the register vector of $\sigma$ by $z$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its input-length register $n$ by $z$.
replaced:
Let a state be a tuple of 17 natural-number registers, in order: input length, halving
count, add-twice counter, window radius, code-bound exponent, code bound, doubling
scratch register, stage, stage plus one, known-ball size, outer vertex, next-ball count,
inner vertex, inner count, guessed code, current walk code, and walk step count. For any
such state σ and natural number z, replacing coordinate 0 of its associated vector by z
gives the vector associated with the state obtained by replacing its input-length
register by z.
